Its remaining approximately 32 months have no identified funding or host commitment. The dossier therefore does not establish how this advertised appointment can be supported.
issues.fix: State the funding source and commitment covering the appointment after April 2028, or revise the advertised duration and recruitment status to reflect the funding actually secured. Register the resulting commitment or funding limitation in dossier.yaml.

issues.where: calisorb_summary_report.md, Methods and Analytical performance; resources_ip_permissions.md, Portable prototype readers
issues.problem: The central sensitivity claim needs a physically credible quantitative basis. At the stated diclofenac LOD of 0.06 µg/L, the 10 mL sample delivered during enrichment contains only 0.6 ng of analyte. Detecting this through the direct refractive-index response of a β-cyclodextrin-grafted top layer, using a reader with 0.02 nm peak-position precision, is a demanding claim. The dossier supplies no measured wavelength sensitivity, differential blank noise, effective sensing area or enrichment capacity connecting the assay to that LOD. Standard addition and temperature correction do not themselves establish sufficient optical sensitivity.
issues.fix: Supply a mutually consistent measured calibration slope in nm per µg/L, differential blank variability, active sensing geometry and enrichment measurements supporting the LOD and linear range. Explain any improvement of differential precision over the quoted reader precision. If those quantities cannot support the claim, revise the analytical performance or sensing mechanism and propagate the changes through the report and facts registry.
